content:
Create instructions for a single scanner to perform.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the scanner.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
string
Enum: "restart"
"settings"
scanner_uuid
required
type
required
Content type
The type of instruction to perform. To restart the scanner service, choose
restart . To modify settings, choose settings .
Restart Scanner Service (OPTION 1) (object) or Change Settings (OPTION 2)
(object)
Specifies the instructions you wish to send to the scanner. The options
object is different depending on whether you want to restart the scanner
service or change settings for the scanner.
